issue.title: [Sev1] orders-api-5xx-rate fired for orders-api
issue.body:
Alert orders-api-5xx-rate fired at 2026-11-18T09:52:00Z.

More than 5% of requests to orders-api failed with a 5xx status for 5 minutes.

Runbook: high-error-rate

comments.body: Some orders fail after a long wait. Morning traffic is higher than usual. The database team says orders-db CPU is at 20% and queries look fast. Asked the agent for a triage.
